summary: Color is a numeric attribute that ties a traffic engineering tunnel or policy to an intent, such as low latency. This document extends PCEP so that the color can be carried between path computation elements and clients.

eli5.summary: Color-coding your lunch boxes tells you what is inside. A route can be tagged with a color for what it is good at, such as fast or cheap, and PCEP can now carry that tag.
